document.abstract: This Recommended Practice describes techniques for specifying jitter in self-clocking, bit-serial digital systems. It is applicable to sources, receivers, and regenerators. It is specifically intended for, but not limited to, 270 Mb/s to 12 Gb/s serial systems as defined by: SMPTE ST 259, SMPTE ST 292-1, SMPTE ST 424, SMPTE ST 435-3, SMPTE ST 2036-4, SMPTE ST 2081-1, and SMPTE ST 2082-1. Methods for measuring these specifications are found in SMPTE RP 192.
